architectureRecommendations.recommendation: Record acquisition, ownership, capability, resource scope and qualification separately. vendor-device and pkce-key-bootstrap are not assumed conventional public OAuth.
Stable local AccountId owns inference and optional monitor capabilities. Reconnect replaces credential on same account, checks upstream identity again, never creates implicit extra budget.
Reuse IQualifiedLoginAdapter/LoginOperationService with small provider modules and additive operation target/purpose/method/resource/revision binding; no plugin engine.

Allow account with monitor capability but no inference credential/route. Remove artificial api-key-only and SecretStore-inference-file prerequisite through a narrow capability projection, not dummy API key.
Never refresh/revoke external snapshots or upgrade imported refresh material to owned session. Owned OAuth has separate private lifecycle store and private access projection.

Single-flight refresh per credential; atomic rotation; preserve omitted refresh token; generation check prevents callback/refresh resurrection after disconnect; invalid_grant reauth, not infinite retry.

Monitor unlink, local account removal, credential cleanup, CLI global logout and provider revoke are distinct. Existing AccountService.Remove retains secrets for in-flight work, so do not label it secure credential deletion.
Retain atomic private 0700/0600 storage, secret-free DTOs, no credentials in args/logs/status. File permissions are not encryption. Delegated CLI secrets remain private and are never echoed.
Independent monitor must not start Core or issue inference. Passive headers require genuine traffic and otherwise stay awaiting-observation/stale. Auth success never implies fresh quota.
Keep rate remaining, spend cap, prepaid funds, subscription allowance and measured usage separate; permissions errors and missing data are not zero. Record scope and freshness per source.

findings.finding: Current official /credits reference requires Management key; old inventory ordinary-key assumption cannot be generalized. Parent reports historical local ordinary-key 200, so documentation does not prove all standard keys always fail. Qualify legacy behavior separately.

MonitorAccessService requires api-key AccountDto, HostQuotaSource requires account secret before yielding monitor credential. Standalone monitor OAuth/session accounts currently cannot exist honestly.
Guide says any key while specific usageCosts ACCOUNT explicitly requires Admin; specific endpoint rights must win. SELF remains useful and separately labeled.
Usage guide overview says no per-key costs but same guide and specific usageCosts reference document them. signin vs login differs too; prefer specific command/reference and qualify version.
Kilo vendor-device, OpenCode fixed CLI client_id, MiMo/Vibe custom keybootstrap and xAI Grok Build credentials do not by themselves authorize a distributed lain client or the desired billing product.
Samba passive-header-first and Cohere local-call-first are Gateway enhancements, not standalone Monitor implementation. Console/CLI reader still needs qualification.

Step Plan usage implementation is source evidence with backend rollout open; Cloudflare mirror neuron field is schema candidate. Do not collapse source, implementation, entitlement and live read into supported=yes.

AI_STUDIO StaticKeySpec currently supports service accounts only; PKCE primitives and Token Factory SSO CLI do not establish a complete personal no-copy login or financial read. Additional serviceaccount/provisioning is neither implicit nor authorized in this research.

Public third-party client registration, mandatory S256 and state, apikey:create produce key accepted for current_balance. Highest-value login completion alongside OpenRouter. Production loopback exception must not be inferred from local-development wording.

billingUsage current schema includes costNanoUsd although guide calls endpoint quantities-only. Schema says only huggingface stamps authoritative cost; zero can mean absent, not free. Prefer dedicated rated-cost endpoints.
